title: 小小观星家
prompt:
Edit the provided image as a professional children's coloring-book illustrator. Maintain the established confident flowing black contours on pure white, playful organic shapes, and generous finger-coloring areas. No shading, gray, color, texture, text or watermark. Hard maximum20 white enclosed coloring regions across the whole picture, with no substantive tiny/narrow white compartments.

Keep the same adorable rabbit at the telescope, crescent moon, star and broad stand. Remove the narrow white eyepiece collar between rabbit eye and telescope barrel: erase the ONE curved dividing contour where that collar joins the main barrel so the white collar becomes a seamless broad continuation of the main telescope body. The eye-contact end can remain a single curved outer outline, but no tiny ring or white tube compartment. Preserve everything else.
previousPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only about 8 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: A large-headed cute little bunny leans eagerly into ONE rounded, oversized telescope, one eye gently closed and its ears tilted playfully. ONE large crescent moon and ONE large simple star in otherwise empty white background. A simple broad two-legged stand supports the telescope; no knobs, screws, narrow tube rings, buttons, straps or complex crossing tripod geometry. Bunny paws are broad mittens, face minimal and expressive, with solid black visible eye if needed and no highlights. The telescope body consists of only two or three broad shapes. Aim about 8 large enclosed colorable regions, strict total maximum 20 including background.

Critical simplicity margin: plan only 8 broad enclosed regions so the finished drawing stays below 20. Every enclosed white patch must be roomy, at least about 60 pixels across at 1024 resolution. Draw mouths ONLY as one open black smile curve, never an outlined open mouth with a small white cavity. No white eye highlights, tiny cheek circles, little pompom compartments or double-outline slivers.

Do not add any objects beyond this minimal scene. Keep total white color pockets around 8; do not add thin cuffs, borders, face frames, enclosed smile holes or narrow enclosed rings.
